RELATIONSHIP.CONDITIONS: Condições de aplicação (todas devem ser atendidas)
RELATIONSHIP.CSAT_NATIVE_RULES: O envio reutiliza o CSAT nativo: conversa resolvida, caixa habilitada e regras do canal. A frequência configurada é respeitada.
RELATIONSHIP.SHARED_PRODUCT_FACTORS: Contrato, suporte, financeiro e relacionamento usam as fontes do cliente. Adoção por produto exige uma medida com evidência.
RELATIONSHIP.NICO_PRIORITIES: Hoje: {today} ações · Vencidas: {overdue} · Clientes em risco: {risk}
RELATIONSHIP.NICO_REVIEW_DAILY: Solicitar resumo do dia ao NICO
RELATIONSHIP.NICO_REVIEW_PROMPT: O NICO consulta o contexto autorizado. Ações sensíveis e envios externos exigem confirmação no copiloto.
RELATIONSHIP.NICO_DISABLED: Ative o NICO nas configurações da conta para solicitar análises.

NICO_PROMPTS.daily: Consulte minha carteira de Relacionamento pelo recurso list_relationship_portfolio e prepare um resumo das prioridades de hoje, riscos, ações vencidas e recomendações com evidências. Não execute alterações ou envios.
NICO_PROMPTS.draft: Use read_relationship_customer com assignment_id {id} e redija uma mensagem ou e-mail para o cliente com base no contexto autorizado. Apresente o rascunho para revisão; não envie mensagens nem altere registros.
NICO_PROMPTS.qbr: Use read_relationship_customer com assignment_id {id} e o qbr_context autorizado para preparar pauta e resumo do período, tickets, adoção, financeiro, riscos e compromissos. Não execute alterações ou envios.
NICO_PROMPTS.summary: Use read_relationship_customer com assignment_id {id} e prepare um resumo executivo 360° com evidências autorizadas. Não execute alterações ou envios.
NICO_PROMPTS.risk: Use read_relationship_customer com assignment_id {id} para explicar os riscos e fatores de Health Score, suas evidências e possíveis planos de retenção. Não execute alterações ou envios.
NICO_PROMPTS.next_action: Use read_relationship_customer com assignment_id {id} para sugerir a próxima ação de relacionamento, retenção, renovação ou expansão com evidências. Não execute alterações ou envios.

RELATIONSHIP.NO_HEALTH_HISTORY: Ainda não há histórico autorizado para este período.
RELATIONSHIP.NO_HEALTH_CHANGE: Ainda não há duas medições comparáveis com variação neste período.
RELATIONSHIP.RENEWAL_WINDOW_EXPLANATION: Faixas exclusivas de dias até o vencimento: 91–120, 61–90, 31–60, 16–30 e 0–15. Contratos vencidos aparecem separadamente.
RELATIONSHIP.EMPTY_PORTFOLIO_GUIDANCE: A carteira recebe clientes após o go-live elegível ou atribuição autorizada. Clientes cadastrados não entram automaticamente só por existir no Cadastro Mestre. Para clientes já implantados, o administrador pode simular o backfill controlado.
RELATIONSHIP.CONFIGURATION_CHANGE: A configuração de cálculo mudou entre estas medições.

AGGREGATIONS.ratio: Taxa calculada sobre os registros do período
AGGREGATIONS.cohort: Receita de abertura e fechamento da mesma carteira

RELATIONSHIP.NATIVE_CSAT_GUIDANCE: NPS e CES relacionais usam as pesquisas abaixo. CSAT é consumido das respostas nativas das Conversas; clique no indicador para consultar as respostas e abrir a conversa de origem. O período filtra respostas recebidas.

MISSING_POLICIES.neutral: Use 50 as a neutral value and show imputation
MISSING_POLICIES.block: Do not calculate while evidence is missing

SURVEY_ADMIN.OFF_GUIDANCE: New models start as drafts and new rules are disabled. Engine activation is managed separately in account settings.
SURVEY_ADMIN.NAME: Name
SURVEY_ADMIN.QUESTION: Question
SURVEY_ADMIN.CONDITIONAL: Show based on an earlier answer
SURVEY_ADMIN.PREVIEW_GUIDANCE: Simulation checks an authorized origin and shows the selected rule and decision reason. It does not schedule surveys, send messages or change activation.

reasons.commercial_origin_changed: Source contract or product changed after publication

REASONS.definition_not_available: Survey definition is outside its published validity period

TEMPLATE.TITLE: Approved WhatsApp template
TEMPLATE.GUIDANCE: Optional configuration. Select an approved template for this inbox and fill a body variable with the survey link marker. This selection saves the rule only; it does not send a message or enable automation.
TEMPLATE.MARKER: Use this marker for the signed survey link:
TEMPLATE.MARKER_REQUIRED: The preview and a body parameter must contain the survey link marker.
TEMPLATE.VERSION_BOUND: Bound to the approved template version. Select it again after a template update.
TEMPLATE.EXPLICIT_SELECTION: Select a WhatsApp inbox and an execution member first.

HANDOFF.GUIDANCE: Review authorized commercial and implementation records before accepting the transfer to Customer Success.

RELATIONSHIP.PLAYBOOK_PLANNED_GUIDANCE: Created tasks follow their own delivery and completion status.
RELATIONSHIP.RENEWAL_CONFIGURED_EXPLANATION: Ranges use the selected configuration and do not overlap. The overdue range contains expired contracts.

ELIGIBILITY_MODES.active_contract_product: Active signed contract and active product (recommended for the new policy)

RELATIONSHIP.ELIGIBILITY_EXCEPTION_GUIDANCE: Use only when the active commercial policy needs a documented exception. The reason, approving manager and date are audited.
RELATIONSHIP.SURVEY_TREND: Daily response trend for the selected period (last 90 days by default)

SURVEY_METRICS.average_score: Average score on the published scale

PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.GUIDANCE: Select the customer and explicit flow references. Preview creates no records. Native flow effects are disabled by default.
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.TITLE: Preview the complete playbook
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.RUN: Confirm and run the reviewed published playbook
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.EXPIRED: The approval expired. Preview and review again.
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.UNVERIFIED: The execution could not be verified. Refresh its history before retrying.
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.VERIFIED: Execution {id} persisted and verified. Consult history for native continuation and delivery status.
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.INVALID_MESSAGE: Use an explicit positive native message ID
PLAYBOOK_PREVIEW.MESSAGE_GUIDANCE: Required for a keyword Flow. Select the exact incoming public customer message from this conversation; no most recent message is inferred.

MANUAL_ATTENDANCE.GUIDANCE: Use an existing customer contact and CRM deal. A completed attendance uses one survey cycle and the configured policy; no channel or contact is chosen automatically.
MANUAL_ATTENDANCE.TITLE: Record manual attendance

FLOW_POLICY.TITLE: Reviewed native Flow policy
FLOW_POLICY.GUIDANCE: Effects remain OFF until explicitly enabled. Phase approval, pilots and current permissions are checked again at every continuation and effect. Enter only existing authorized IDs.
FLOW_POLICY.UNASSIGNED_UNIT: Allow customers without a business unit
FLOW_POLICY.INVALID: Use distinct positive existing IDs and whole numbers within the displayed limits.

RELATIONSHIP.SURVEY_COHORT_REQUIRED: Select the enrollment period to calculate response and delivery rates. Response dates alone do not define eligibility.

SURVEY_PREPARATION.TITLE: Signed survey QR and local voice preparation
SURVEY_PREPARATION.UNVERIFIED: Survey identity or published version could not be verified
SURVEY_PREPARATION.QR: QR code for this signed survey link
SURVEY_PREPARATION.DRY_RUN_GUIDANCE: This local preview validates the published questions. It does not call a customer, transcribe audio or save a response. A telephony adapter must be configured separately.
SURVEY_PREPARATION.CONDITIONAL: The published response parser applies this question's condition
SURVEY_PREPARATION.VERIFIED: Published parser preview verified; no answer saved

RELATIONSHIP.SURVEY_TEMPLATE_WINDOW: The 24-hour window is closed. Select an approved template for this inbox to send the survey link.
RELATIONSHIP.SURVEY_TEMPLATE_LINK: Insert this exact signed link into the approved template body parameter:
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVOLUTION_BASIS: Recurring amounts from actual authorized snapshots, not cash receipts. Missing days are not filled. Partial coverage is shown separately from the complete portfolio total.
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVOLUTION_LIMIT: The observation limit was exceeded. Narrow the customer or date filters.
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVOLUTION_EMPTY: No authorized observations exist in this period.
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Customer observations conflict; no value was selected.
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVIDENCE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A positive amount has no proven contract source.
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVIDENCE_CUSTOMER_CHANGED: The historical source no longer belongs to the current customer scope.
RELATIONSHIP.MRR_EVIDENCE_OVERLAP: This contract is referenced by more than one customer cohort; it was not counted twice.
